SimConnect_Open

Opens a new connection between the client application and the Flight Simulator server.

Syntax

SIMCONNECTAPI SimConnect_Open(HANDLE * phSimConnect, LPCSTR szName, HWND hWnd, DWORD UserEventWin32, HANDLE hEventHandle, DWORD ConfigIndex)

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
phSimConnect HANDLE * Address of a variable that receives the SimConnect connection handle.
szName LPCSTR Null-terminated string containing the name of the client application.
hWnd HWND Handle to the application window.
UserEventWin32 DWORD A Win32 user-defined message identifier.
hEventHandle HANDLE A Win32 event handle created with CreateEvent.
ConfigIndex DWORD Zero-based index into the SimConnect.cfg configuration blocks.

Return value

Returns HRESULT. Use SUCCEEDED() or FAILED() macros to test.

Remarks

SimConnect_Open must be called before any other SimConnect function.
